title: Landscape: AgentiCCells and agentic sales
for: landscape.d and strategy.d (what it means); the players and facts are landscape.d's, the placing is my reading

sources_read.landscape: board/team/landscape.d/landscapes/agentic-sales/rows.json (landscape-rows/1 with group, made 2026-11-23T05:30Z), read 23 Nov 2026; the facts and URLs are in landscape.json beside it
sources_read.cartographer: cartographer.d's reading of each group's evolution and where the groups sit; where a player sits inside its group means nothing

axes.y: visibility to the buyer (1 = what they see first)
axes.x: evolution: genesis 0, custom 0.25, product 0.5, commodity 0.75 to 1

nodes.label: AgentiCCells (us)
nodes.evidence: Sells agentic cells: small teams of AI agents (conductor, designer, writer, developer, reviewer and others), each with a role, brief and written behaviour policy, working on one focused job in the buyer's own accounts. Price: Four fixed one-off first-proposal sizes: £500 one agent or workflow, £1,500 a few sessions, £5,000 a team (about two days), £20,000 a network; none sold yet, terms may change; sovereign website launch offer £50 once.. https://agenticcells.ai/cells/ (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Relevance AI
nodes.evidence: Sells an AI workforce with named agents such as Research & Enricher, Outbound Prospector, Meeting Scheduler, Deal Reviewer, Proposal Builder, Ticket Triager and Invoice Matcher. Price: Pricing page lists a single Enterprise plan via sales with no public price points and only custom vendor credits mentioned.. https://www.relevanceai.com/agents (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: 11x
nodes.evidence: Sells AI sales agents called digital workers: Alice for outbound prospecting, Julian for inbound and expansion by voice and chat, Nina as voice agent. Price: No pricing published; visitors are directed to book a demo.. https://www.11x.ai (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Lindy
nodes.evidence: Sold as seats plus monthly credit bundles, with credits metering the work the agent does. Price: Free plan with $50 credits for 7 days; Team from $29.99 per user per month with 3,000 credits pooled; top-ups $10 per 1,000 credits; Enterprise custom.. https://www.lindy.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Intercom Fin
nodes.evidence: Sells Fin, an AI customer service and sales agent that works with Intercom or existing helpdesks such as Zendesk, Salesforce and Freshdesk. Price: $0.99 per outcome charged at most once per conversation, nothing if the customer asks for a human; voice $1.99 per outcome; $49 per month minimum on existing helpdesk; Intercom seats $19 per month.. https://fin.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Devin (Cognition)
nodes.evidence: Sells Devin coding agents as individual and team plans with add-ons such as Devin Bots, Cloud and API. Price: Free $0; Pro $20 per month; Max $200 per month; Teams $80 per month up to 100 users; Enterprise custom; extra usage at API pricing.. https://devin.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-23)

nodes.label: Botpress
nodes.evidence: Sells AI agents priced on conversations handled rather than seats, with a small AI-usage allowance included per conversation. Price: Free $0 (100 conversations); Plus $150 per month and Team $750 per month billed annually; extra conversation packs of 100 at $65 or $50; Enterprise custom.. https://botpress.com/pricing (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: Salesforce Agentforce
nodes.evidence: Sells agent usage and licences inside its CRM suite: Flex Credits per action, per-conversation pricing, and per-user licences and add-ons. Price: Flex Credits $500 per 100k credits (20 credits per action, £400 listed in GBP); conversations $2 (£1.60); user licence $5 per user per month; Coworker licence $50 per user per month; add-ons $150 to $175 per user per month.. https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/pricing/ (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

nodes.label: Microsoft Copilot Studio
nodes.evidence: Credit packs of 25,000 credits at $200 per month, or pay-as-you-go billed monthly in arrears, or prepaid commit saving up to 20%; agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot are covered by that licence. Price: Credit packs of 25,000 credits at $200 per month, or pay-as-you-go billed monthly in arrears, or prepaid commit saving up to 20%; agents published to Microsoft 365 Copilot are covered by that licence.. https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot/microsoft-copilot-studio (read 2026-11-23)
